about: Painted reel symbols for Lucky 7 (l7_*) and Slots (sea_*), the casino menu's game icons (menu_*) and the house card back, 2026-10-11. Higgsfield gpt_image_2_5 flare, medium, 1k, 1:1, background transparent, 0.5 credit each, no reference images. Post: alpha 254->255, haze <6 dropped, tight crop, centred at 94% of a square (Lucky 7 320 px, Slots 256 px), premultiplied LANCZOS; <name>_b.png is the same symbol at half size with a vertical box blur of +-16% of its height (the cells racing past while a reel spins). Both quantised to a 256-colour palette (FASTOCTREE + Floyd-Steinberg). Raw 1024 px renders: download again from the job ids.

style.l7: Slot-machine reel symbol for the royal casino of a painted fantasy RPG. SUBJECT: <subject>. Style: polished hand-painted game icon, chunky readable silhouette, deep saturated jewel colours, glossy specular highlights, a warm golden rim light, a crisp dark outline and a soft magical glow around the edges. Centred and filling about 80% of a square canvas, seen straight from the front. Isolated on a fully transparent background: no backdrop, no frame, no tile, no reel, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers.
style.sea: Slot-machine reel symbol for a sunken-treasure sea slot machine in a painted fantasy RPG casino. SUBJECT: <subject>. Style: polished hand-painted game icon, chunky readable silhouette, glossy specular highlights, a cool aqua-teal rim light from the sea, a crisp dark outline and a soft glow around the edges. (Low symbols: 'Low-value ... Muted, weathered colours'.) Isolated on a fully transparent background: no backdrop, no water, no frame, no tile, no reel, no floor or cast shadow, no text.
